events.whyItMatters: Curaleaf has raised its hostile bid by 25% without Aurora's cooperation: 0.4013 Curaleaf subordinate voting shares plus US$1.00 cash per share, an implied US$5.00 and an 86% premium to Aurora's unaffected 30-day VWAP, with the cap lifted to US$6.00 and the expiry pushed to 4 December 2026. Raising the bid while both sides' Alberta Securities Commission applications are still pending shows Curaleaf would rather pay more than wait, and it tests whether Aurora's board can keep holders on 'take no action' without a rival bid or a defence of its own. The underlying argument is unchanged: Curaleaf is bidding mostly in its own paper for a cash pile and an international medical footprint.

phases.headline: Curaleaf to take offer directly to shareholders in bid to buy Edmonton-based Aurora Cannabis
phases.priceReaction: ACB rallied on the announcement

events.whyItMatters: Copart is paying $10.50 a share in cash -- about $1.9bn, a 45% premium -- through a tender offer for ACV Auctions, buying its way out of pure salvage and into the digital wholesale market for ordinary used dealer cars, with ACV run as an independent subsidiary and closing targeted by year-end.

events.whyItMatters: A BASF takeover of Evonik would be the biggest consolidation in German chemicals in years, and RAG-Stiftung's roughly 43.8% stake -- not Evonik's board, which says there are no talks -- decides whether it happens.

phases.headline: BASF Made Merger Proposal to German Rival Evonik, FT Reports

events.whyItMatters: Gold Fields has put a price on Australia's largest gold miner -- 0.3125 Gold Fields shares plus A$7.25 cash per share, about A$38.7bn and a 22% premium to the 11 September close -- and Northern Star's board has unanimously rejected it as opportunistic, mostly paper and heavily conditional. The stock still trading below the implied value after a 10% jump says the market doubts a knockout bid, but with Elliott already pushing for a strategy and board review, Northern Star is now in play: the question is whether Gold Fields sweetens the cash component or a rival emerges.

phases.headline: Australia's Northern Star rejects $27 billion takeover approach from Gold Fields
phases.priceReaction: +10.6% to A$24.46 in early Monday trading, below the implied offer value

phases.headline: Gold Fields Said to Weigh Sweetening Northern Star Bid With Cash
Gold Fields CEO plays down talk of raising its offer for Northern Star

events.whyItMatters: The US DOJ closed its second-request investigation into Transocean's $5.8bn all-stock purchase of Valaris (15.235 RIG shares per VAL share) without remedies, clearing the biggest hurdle to creating an offshore driller worth about $17bn in enterprise value that will own a large share of the high-spec floater and jackup fleet; with only Brazil left, a Q4 2026 close now looks likely, and the combined fleet gives the new company far more pricing power in deepwater contracting.

phases.headline: Transocean, Valaris receive US antitrust approval
Brazil Clears Transocean's Planned $5.8 Billion Valaris Acquisition

events.counterparty: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena (BMPS.MI)
events.whyItMatters: Intesa Sanpaolo has raised its cash-and-share offer for Monte dei Paschi to 1.6 new Intesa shares plus EUR1.25 cash per share, about EUR800m more than before, but pays the extra only if MPS holders vote down MPS's own all-share bids for Banco BPM and Banca Generali on 29 October; if either passes, Intesa can walk away. With Delfin committing its 17.6% stake, Intesa is now close to forming the eurozone's second-largest bank by market value, and the 29 October vote decides whether Italian banking consolidates around Intesa or around MPS.

phases.headline: Italy's Intesa raises MPS takeover offer price and warns it could drop bid
Intesa Says Its Paschi Bid Backed by Top Shareholder Delfin
Monte dei Paschi says Intesa's raised offer still too low
phases.priceReaction: MPS and Intesa shares up about 1% in early trading the next day

phases.headline: Italy's Intesa gets ECB authorisation to take over Monte dei Paschi

events.whyItMatters: The FT reports that Starbucks, now run by former Chipotle CEO Brian Niccol, has worked with advisers on a takeover proposal for Chipotle, which is worth about $39bn against Starbucks' roughly $107bn. That would be the largest restaurant deal ever, but no offer is known to have been made, analysts see few synergies, and it would need heavy borrowing or share issuance. Starbucks' early 6% drop shows its own holders would carry the cost, and TD Cowen calls it a low-probability outcome.

phases.headline: Starbucks has explored Chipotle takeover, FT reports
phases.priceReaction: CMG up as much as 8%, SBUX down as much as 6%, both later pared moves

phases.headline: Starbucks says it is not buying Chipotle after takeover speculation
phases.priceReaction: CMG down nearly 4% in morning trading; SBUX up about 1%

events.whyItMatters: Roughly $8bn in cash for nationwide 800 MHz low-band spectrum gives Starlink the indoor-coverage layer it lacked to run as a standalone US mobile carrier, turning SpaceX into a direct competitor to AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile pending FCC approval.

phases.headline: SpaceX takes aim at US wireless carriers with spectrum acquisition
phases.priceReaction: Crown Castle +13%; AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile lower

events.whyItMatters: An unsolicited $2bn all-cash bid for SVC's roughly 92-hotel portfolio is worth more than the REIT's whole equity value and would let a heavily indebted SVC exit lodging in one step and pay down its looming maturities, leaving a pure net-lease business; the board has only confirmed receipt, had no prior contact with TKO, and has not engaged.

phases.headline: Service Properties stock jumps after TKO offers to buy hospitality portfolio for $2B
phases.priceReaction: SVC closed up about 15% at $7.15

events.whyItMatters: Reuters' sources say the $25bn AkzoNobel-Axalta coatings merger will win conditional EU clearance only if AkzoNobel offers to sell a vehicle-refinish business -- the main remaining overlap after powder-coatings concerns were resolved -- with a formal remedy pushing the Commission's 22 October deadline back by 10 working days. That trades away part of the refinish franchise that underpins the deal's synergy case in exchange for avoiding a months-long Phase 2 probe, and with AkzoNobel already shrinking its Asian decorative arm, its investment case now rests on closing this merger.

phases.headline: AkzoNobel, Axalta set to win EU antitrust nod for $25 billion deal, sources say
AkzoNobel, Axalta offer remedies in bid for EU approval for $25 billion deal

events.whyItMatters: STERIS pays ~$2.1bn, mostly debt-funded, for a ~$245m-revenue, ~55%-EBIT-margin OR safety consumables maker — about 15x EBIT net of tax benefits — tilting its healthcare mix toward recurring consumables while lifting leverage ahead of a promised fiscal-2027 outlook revision.

phases.headline: Steris buys surgical products maker Xodus Medical for $2.1 billion

events.whyItMatters: IonQ is spending up to $1.3bn in its own stock (price-collared at $33.07–$49.61) to buy a zero-trust network security firm, adding dilution but giving it a revenue-bearing enterprise security channel to sell post-quantum cryptography and QKD into today rather than waiting on quantum computing demand.

phases.headline: IonQ to Acquire Zero Trust Firm Elisity for Up to $1.3 Billion

events.whyItMatters: Nokia exits its ~900-customer enterprise campus private-wireless business, a unit already booked as discontinued operations, completing another step of Hotard's restructuring to narrow the group onto core network infrastructure and AI/data-centre networking — no price was disclosed, so the signal is focus rather than cash.

phases.headline: Nokia to sell Enterprise Campus Edge business to AURELIUS

events.whyItMatters: Ithaca, a newly formed vehicle led by Ravi Gupta and John Hegeman, will pay $6.05 a share in cash, about $1.3bn and a ~138% premium to the 9 October close, with founder Whitney Wolfe Herd expected to roll part of her stake. The size of the premium says more about how far Bumble's public valuation had collapsed (paying users down 11% in 2025, Q2 revenue down 15%) than about a growth story, and it caps the upside for holders while marking a private-market floor for shrinking dating-app peers like Match.

phases.headline: Bumble agrees to a $1.3B acquisition deal as online dating faces a reset
phases.priceReaction: BMBL soared more than 50% on 12 October on reports of advanced take-private talks

events.whyItMatters: Fairfax commits roughly ₹52,878 crore (~$6bn) for a controlling 60.72% of IDBI Bank at ₹81 a share, its biggest bet on India and the largest-ever FDI into Indian financial services — still subject to RBI fit-and-proper clearance and a mandatory open offer to minorities.

phases.headline: Centre approves Fairfax Financial’s ₹52,878 crore bid for 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank

events.whyItMatters: Portugal picked Lufthansa's all-cash bid of about €1.0bn for 44.9% of TAP (up to €1.2bn for 49.9%) over Air France-KLM, handing Lufthansa a Lisbon hub with strong Brazil and Africa routes — contracts and EU approval still to come.

phases.headline: Lufthansa wins race for $1.3 billion stake in Portuguese carrier TAP

events.whyItMatters: EU clearance for Kimberly-Clark's ~$49bn Kenvue takeover costs only its EEA feminine-care brands (to Dilek Grup), leaving China's in-depth review as the main hurdle before the consumer-health combination can close.

phases.headline: Kimberly-Clark gets conditional EU approval for Kenvue acquisition
Kimberly-Clark's $40B purchase of Kenvue wins China antitrust approval

phases.headline: LSEG in Talks to Buy Permira-Owned Credit Firm Octus
phases.priceReaction: -4.7% intraday

phases.headline: LSEG Seals $3.5 Billion Octus Deal as Group Fights Back AI Fears

events.whyItMatters: Piper Sandler's talks to buy Perella Weinberg broke down over financial terms and personnel, removing the takeover premium priced into PWP since the late-September WSJ report and leaving it as a standalone mid-sized advisory boutique.

phases.headline: Perella Weinberg Drops After Report of Deal Talks Abandoned

phases.headline: Penske Automotive to go private in $16.3 billion deal led by Penske Corp, Mitsui

phases.headline: CCC Intelligent Solutions Signs Definitive Agreement to Be Acquired by GTCR and Elliott

events.whyItMatters: ECB clearance lets UniCredit take delivery of tendered shares beyond its ~48% stake and move to control of Commerzbank over Berlin's objections, making a board overhaul and UniCredit's profit plan the likely path for Commerzbank holders.

phases.headline: Italy's UniCredit wins ECB approval to control Germany's Commerzbank

events.whyItMatters: International Seaways is buying Oslo-listed Bruton and its four VLCCs (including newbuildings) for about $370m, paid ~96% in roughly 3.12m new INSW shares: a first-step exchange for ~50.5% of Bruton settling around 20 October and a cash-and-stock merger vote around 30 October, adding very-large-crude-carrier exposure to its ~70-vessel crude and product fleet in stock rather than cash.

phases.headline: International Seaways Announces Agreements to Acquire Bruton Limited

events.whyItMatters: National Fuel Gas will split into a 100% rate-regulated utility and pipeline company and a pure-play Appalachian upstream and gathering company via a tax-free spin of at least 80.1% of IUG, targeted for 2H 2027, separating a steady regulated earner from a commodity-exposed producer so each can be valued and funded on its own terms; NFG keeps up to 19.9% to sell later.

phases.headline: National Fuel Gas Company Announces Plan to Separate Its Integrated Upstream and Gathering Business

events.whyItMatters: $49.75-a-share all-cash, ~$6.3bn deal at a 52% premium to the pre-rumor price caps Varonis's upside at a fixed cash price and takes it private; the year's largest cybersecurity deal, expected to close 1H 2027.

phases.headline: Proofpoint agrees to buy data security company Varonis for $6.3B in cash

events.whyItMatters: EQT Infrastructure has signed a binding scheme to buy Australia's largest waste manager for A$3.095 a share in cash (about A$9.3bn EV), slightly below its A$3.13 August proposal, with a franked special dividend of up to 19c possible and a ticking fee if it runs past March 2027; the unanimous board recommendation turns Cleanaway into a fixed-price arb, with FIRB, ACCC, court and a February 2027 vote left to clear.

phases.headline: EQT agrees to acquire Cleanaway, a leading Australian integrated waste management and resource recovery platform
phases.priceReaction: CWY up about 19-20%

events.whyItMatters: New Hope is issuing 0.5 of its own shares per Malabar share (about A$1.8bn equity, A$2.4bn EV) to take full control of the Maxwell underground mine it already owns 26% of, creating a ~A$6.3bn coal group in which Malabar holders get 21%; it doubles down on Hunter Valley coal in paper rather than cash, so New Hope holders take dilution for a mine still ramping toward 5.5Mtpa.

phases.headline: New Hope shares hit near one-month high as it agrees $1.3 bln Malabar deal
phases.priceReaction: NHC at near one-month high

events.whyItMatters: Silgan is folding its metal containers and closures businesses into Trivium (bought for about $3.4bn EV, 7.1x EBITDA) to form a ~$7.3bn metal packaging company, keeping 60% while American Industrial Partners takes 40% for about $1bn in cash equity; Silgan pockets roughly $2.3bn of cash and guides to at least 15% EPS and free-cash-flow accretion, setting up a possible later separation of the metal business, with closing not expected until mid-2027.

phases.headline: Silgan stock surges 5.5% on $3.4B Trivium acquisition deal

events.whyItMatters: European Commission merger clearance removes the last regulatory condition on Daniel Kretinsky's EP Group €35-a-share tender offer for Fnac Darty, which the board backs and an independent expert called fair; with the AMF to set the final timetable and closing expected in early November, the stock is now a short-dated arb and France's largest electronics and books retailer is heading under Kretinsky's control.

phases.headline: Fnac Darty: Merger control clearance from the European Commission of the takeover bid initiated by EP Group

events.whyItMatters: PHP is putting 27 private hospitals (about £0.7bn, transferred at a 5% discount to book) into a 50:50 venture with Singapore's GIC and keeping the asset-management role, raising about £0.5bn to repay variable-rate debt including the rest of the Assura bridge; it cuts net debt from about £3.4bn toward £2.9bn and gives PHP a sovereign capital partner for future growth, at the cost of half the hospital income.

phases.headline: UK's PHP forms joint venture with Singapore's GIC to cut debt

events.whyItMatters: Salesforce's biggest deal since Informatica pays a 58% premium, about $5.66bn EV, to bolt Braze's customer-engagement platform onto its AI marketing stack, a sign that Salesforce is back to buying growth after its margin-first stretch.

phases.headline: Salesforce to acquire Braze in a $5.66 billion deal

phases.headline: Elon Musk says SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to discuss merger idea

events.whyItMatters: An Apollo-backed Legendary bid of about $3.5bn including debt would pin a takeout value on Lionsgate's film and TV library, while activist Anson Funds is already pushing the company to act.

phases.headline: Lionsgate Stock Jumps On Report Of Takeover Offer By Legendary

events.whyItMatters: EQT's €46.50-a-share all-cash offer (about €10.8bn EV, with ADIA and CPP Investments co-investing) is board-recommended and has no financing condition, putting a 40% premium to the undisturbed price on Qiagen; the 50%-plus-one acceptance threshold and regulatory clearances into mid-2027 are what stand between holders and the cash, and KKR's reported rival interest set the floor.

phases.headline: EQT in Advanced Talks to Acquire Qiagen in $10 Billion Healthcare Deal

phases.headline: Tradeweb to Acquire Trumid, Expanding Tradeweb's Credit Capabilities Across the Bond Lifecycle

events.whyItMatters: A $4bn cash exit from Brazil and Mexico is the biggest step yet in Prudential halving its country footprint, freeing capital for asset management, group insurance and European retirement at the cost of its main emerging-market growth engine.

phases.headline: Prudential sheds Brazil, Mexico units to CNP for $4 billion as it narrows its focus

events.whyItMatters: Closing the $2.2bn all-cash Beazer deal makes Dream Finders the sixth-largest US homebuilder; the case now rests on delivering $100m+ of synergies and bringing leverage back down within 18-24 months.

phases.headline: Dream Finders closes $2.2 billion all-cash acquisition of Beazer Homes

events.whyItMatters: Cencora's second big community-oncology buy in under a year (after OneOncology) deepens its bet on owning physician practices, not just distributing drugs to them, adding 350+ providers and 12 states to its MSO platform.

phases.headline: Cencora to acquire majority stake in $2.4B American Oncology Network

phases.headline: CRH Completes Acquisition of Arcosa

events.whyItMatters: UDR sells a two-thirds stake in 19 older communities to Apollo funds for $1.34bn of equity at a ~6% cap rate, recycling capital into its wholly-owned portfolio and balance sheet while keeping control and a buy-back option from year five.

phases.headline: Apollo, UDR Partner on $2B Multifamily Joint Venture

events.whyItMatters: Instacart putting itself up for sale at roughly a $12bn valuation, a fraction of DoorDash's 2021 talks, would hand a delivery rival the US grocery-delivery leader. Any bid from DoorDash or Uber would face heavy antitrust scrutiny.

phases.headline: Couche-Tard proposes up to $8 billion offer for Cumberland Farms, The Times reports

phases.headline: EQT to acquire Range Resources in all-stock deal valued at more than $50 billion

phases.headline: Logan Energy Corp. Announces Agreement To Be Acquired By Ovintiv Inc., For $1.40 Per Share In Cash And The Spin-out Of Logan Oil Corp.

phases.headline: Ingenia Soars on Fresh $1.6 Billion Takeover Bid From AVID

phases.headline: Tata Motors' Iveco bid crosses 80% threshold as acceptances hit 87.81%

phases.headline: Simpson Manufacturing approves $1 billion buyback program

phases.headline: Surgery Partners to Be Acquired by Bon Secours for $5.7 Billion

events.whyItMatters: The largest US BDC is absorbing Apollo's listed BDC for about $10.88 a share in stock and cash (a 30% premium), adding ~$2.6bn of assets and signalling consolidation among sub-scale private-credit vehicles trading below book.

phases.headline: Ares Capital Corporation (ARCC) Reports Strong Q3 Results and Announces MidCap Acquisition

events.whyItMatters: A $9bn cash-and-debt buy of a high-voltage grid equipment maker deepens GE Vernova's Electrification bet on AI-driven grid demand, but trades buyback firepower for a deal that only closes in late 2027.

phases.headline: GE Vernova Agrees to Pay $9 Billion to Acquire Trench Group
